def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # Build maps
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {nid: [] for nid in node_map}
    for n in nodes:
        p = n['parent']
        if p is not None:
            children[p].append(n['id'])
    # Processing order
    order = sorted(node_map.keys(), key=lambda x: (-node_map[x]['depth'], x))
    # State
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    cur_syms = set(n['symbol'] for n in node_map.values())
    removed = []
    for nid in order:
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        node = node_map[nid]
        # Check conditions
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node['parent'] is None:  # root
            continue
        if any(c in retained for c in children.get(nid, [])):
            continue
        # Compute lost nodes (subtree that is still retained)
        lost = set()
        stack = [nid]
        while stack:
            cur = stack.pop()
            if cur in retained:
                lost.add(cur)
                for ch in children.get(cur, []):
                    stack.append(ch)
        lost_syms = set(node_map[x]['symbol'] for x in lost)
        new_syms = cur_syms - lost_syms
        if not required.issubset(new_syms):
            continue
        # Perform removal
        retained -= lost
        cur_syms = new_syms
        removed.append(nid)
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_ids
    }
